turns.text: Thanks for making time, Dana. We'll keep this to the security basics so the deal team has a clean picture. Let's start with identity. How is admin access protected?
Every admin account is behind MFA. No exceptions. That's been true for years. It's enforced through our conditional access policy.
And when someone leaves the company?
Offboarding is automated. HR flags the termination and access is revoked same day through our identity provider.
We have a 24 7 SOC through our MSSP, every alert gets looked at, nothing sits. Email
Email is a big one for us. Our Our portfolio companies get hit with wire fraud attempts constantly. Where are you on spoofing protection?
We're fully locked down there. DMARC is enforced. Nobody can spoof our domain.
Any security incidents in the last few few years?
No, nothing material. We've never had a breach.
What about your external attack surface? Legacy systems, old infrastructure?
We decommissioned the legacy stuff a while back. Everything external goes through the main app and the VPN.
Annual third party test. The last one came back clean. No highs.
Daily backups to immutable storage in a second region and we do a restore test every quarter.
Last one, do you have a bridge letter for the period since your SOC 2 ended?
We can get one. one we haven't needed it so far.
Great, that's what I needed. Thanks, Dana
